goal: Explain and reduce the gap to C64 >=6765.407263214912 frames/s while retaining native top-8 and the confirmed complete WER/SIM bounds; do not use a budget estimate as a stop criterion.
assumptions: 64 / 0.008275 = 7734.139 frames/s is an optimistic full-B64 reference derived from an isolated real-input decode diagnostic, not a proven hardware upper bound, nor a guaranteed serving lower bound.
The exact diagnostic duration is 8.275183868408202 ms; report both exact and rounded arithmetic. Its source/configuration/context and lack of simultaneous codec differ from the latest service.

The reported serving makespan includes every successful request, initial filling, final draining, and benchmark wrapper overhead. Do not remove tails or long/quiet outputs to improve the reported score.

Acoustic frames are audio_samples/2048 and exclude EOS. Full-B64 decode timing includes an autoregressive step; prompt backbone and first-frame tower are separate. Conditional decode-row accounting must distinguish first frames and EOS termination.

Client in-flight intervals include request transport, server admission, prefill, decode, codec and delivery; they do not measure active GPU slots. Dispatch interarrival gaps are mostly completion-driven in this closed-loop benchmark and are not automatically admission stalls.

Output lengths differ stochastically across runs. Preserve per-sample frame differences, max-length outputs, quality and final-drain duration instead of treating elapsed-time differences as constant-work speedups.
A frame's PCM arrival time is a delivery observation, not its model-production time; transport chunks may coalesce or split engine chunks.
Do not transfer the old 384-request synchronous timeline proportions or ideal codec-hiding budget into this asynchronous 1088-request run.
CUDA event spans can include host submission gaps; summing overlapping main/codec stage spans double counts elapsed time. Event union is not SM utilization.
mixed_backbone includes the teacher-forced prefill tower. first_frame CPU wait can wait for prior mixed work; it is not independent CPU computation.

hypotheses_to_test.claim: Continuous-service decode is slowed by overlapping codec bandwidth/compute demand compared with isolated B64.
hypotheses_to_test.test: Within the new timeline compare pure-decode spans by active-batch bucket and overlap with codec, preserving all groups and reporting context/phase confounds; confirm causality only with a same-source controlled experiment.

hypotheses_to_test.claim: Mixed prompt work and teacher tower remain substantial after span trimming.
hypotheses_to_test.test: Count refill rounds, active decode rows, newly admitted prompts, prompt tokens/capacity/span where instrumented; quantify their event unions and slot deficits separately from ordinary decode.

hypotheses_to_test.claim: Client refill or codec delivery leaves meaningful request slots unavailable during continuous intake.
hypotheses_to_test.test: Compare exact client in-flight deficit and completion-to-next-dispatch gaps with server active/pending/codec queues when available; do not infer GPU idle directly from client occupancy.

hypotheses_to_test.claim: Finite-corpus tail materially lowers total throughput.
hypotheses_to_test.test: Retain all requests; report fill, continuous intake, final drain, PCM frames delivered in each interval and active-batch distributions; estimate conditional opportunity rather than subtracting tail from the official metric.

hypotheses_to_test.claim: GPU/CPU handoff gaps remain despite asynchronous codec.
hypotheses_to_test.test: Report main-only, codec-only, both and neither event interval unions; distinguish GPU-domain gaps from host-wall interval and timestamp alignment uncertainty.

required_new_timeline_metrics: Clean source SHA, GPU UUID, effective runtime environment, corpus SHA, request IDs, summary metrics, complete quality when available, profiler enabled status
All 1088 raw dispatch/completion/last-audio timestamps, output frames, chunk arrival bytes and times; warmup retained separately and excluded from measured-window stages
Nonblocking events with stage, cuda_stream, cpu_start_s, cpu_submit_ms, gpu_start_ms, gpu_end_ms, batch
Counts and active-batch distributions for decode and mixed rounds across fill, continuous intake and final drain
Mixed first-frame count per round, padded decode bucket, prompt token sum, packed capacity and max span if recorded; otherwise mark unavailable
Codec event spans, batch/frame bucket if recorded, overlap union with decode/mixed/first-frame, and backlog or host-blocking gaps if recorded
Main-stream model union, codec-stream union, overlap, codec-only/main-only and event-envelope uncovered time; nested codec_submit is not an independent GPU compute stage
Audio delivered before/after last dispatch; request completion quantiles and tail contributors, without excluding any request
Equal-source uninstrumented control/candidate full-corpus output lengths and all-sample quality before claiming any speedup
